measures.name: Public Question
measures.note: No statewide citizen initiatives. Constitutional amendments must pass two separately elected General Assemblies before going to voters, and need a majority of votes cast on the question.

constitutionalNote: This amends the Indiana Constitution; changing it again requires two separately elected General Assemblies and another statewide vote.

retention.note: Justices and Court of Appeals judges face retention at the first general election after two years on the bench, then every 10 years. No Supreme Court justice has lost since 1970.

primarySystem: Partisan primaries; the party nominee advances.

questions.q: Judges on retention ballots run unopposed. When no problem with a judge has been found, what's your default?
questions.note: Indiana uses merit selection; voters only decide whether to keep each appellate judge.
